content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RITES Manager Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-11-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES Manager / Railway Design & Operation recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 07 November 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Manager / Railway Design & Operation post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree in any discipline from a recognised university to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Manager / Railway Design & Operation post is 55 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager / Railway Design & Operation position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RITES Manager / Railway Design & Operation job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Manager / Railway Design & Operation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a scrutiny on a 100-point scale, followed by the creation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.
